invariants.rationale: The method returns the result of an execute method which should never be null, ensuring a non-null result.
preppedRecords is passed to the executor and expected to be non-null for the delete operation to proceed.
instantTime represents a timestamp or version string and should be non-null during the delete operation.
The number of write statuses in the result is at most the number of records processed.
The WriteStatuses list inside result is expected to be non-null.
